Correct you need two unless you purchase a self pollinating plant; otherwise they need to be close and you need to make sure that they are cross-pollinating friendly. Most of the time the tag on the fruit tree will provide the details about pollination. Also important is getting plants that work in your zone. That's why it's best to purchase tree grown locally and not online. If you see it's grown local then you know it works in your zone. Unless you want to spend big money, it's safe to figure that you want see real fruit for 3-5 years. but once a fruit tree start providing, you'll be happy you went through the trouble. Another thing to remember is, trees don't live forever, so plant new trees ever few years so that you'll always have a backup tree should something happen to one of your trees.
